title: Starter readiness verification descriptor
note: This is a starter-local readiness descriptor, NOT an artifact-chain Implementation Plan. It names the deterministic gate layers run by `.tooling/scripts/starter-verify-runner.mjs <layer>`; it is NOT passed to `vibe-engineer verify`. `vibe-engineer verify --implementation-plan <path>` consumes ONLY a real, operator-approved Implementation Plan 2.0.0 (a v2-only intake gate runs first); pointing verify at this descriptor fails closed with the stable CLI code VE_VERIFY_PLAN_INTAKE_VERSION_REJECTED (typed gate code ARTIFACT_KIND_MISMATCH). A real Implementation Plan 2.0.0 is produced by the plan skill for actual work, never shipped as a starter fixture.
objective: Run the generated starter's deterministic local-only quality gates through `.tooling/scripts/starter-verify-runner.mjs <layer>`; this is not public, live, package, hosted, or product proof.

notApplicableLayers.rationale: No generated safety hook runner; add one per-project when needed.
Deterministic package gates fail closed on runner/evidence errors; no separate mechanical gate is generated.
The starter self-check starts no external services.
Compile/unit coverage covers generated contracts; no separate adapter runner is generated.
Full E2E is excluded from the default local verify command.
Browser/device UI verification is excluded from the default local verify command.
No AI evaluation runner is generated for the starter self-check.
No separate context drift runner is generated for the starter self-check.
No observability runner is generated for the starter self-check.
architecture-agent-review is a separate selected-harness surface; live/model-backed review is outside this deterministic offline readiness verify.
Only local deterministic starter DoD is recorded; public/live/package/product DoD requires separate evidence.
The starter descriptor and evidence packets are schema-validated by vibe-engineer verify at execution time.

durableMemory.note: Evidence Packet 2.0.0 JSON + digests are tracked; only archive-tier bulky sidecars are ignored (DL-33 two-tier).

rerunHints: Use --rerun-of with a prior run-id when comparing readiness attempts.
